description: This file defines the ListCVDsAction struct and its associated methods for listing CVDs in the Android Cuttlefish orchestrator. It includes functionality to filter groups and interact with the CVD CLI component to retrieve fleet information.

classes.name: ListCVDsActionOpts
classes.description: Options for creating a new ListCVDsAction, including group filter, paths, execution context, and user.

classes.name: ListCVDsAction
classes.description: Contains configuration and state for listing CVDs, including methods to run the action.

methods.description: Constructor function to create a new ListCVDsAction with specified options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the action to list CVDs, optionally filtering by group.
